name: Game News
summary: A News tab on each game's library page, and a News Tome on your Desk.
description:
Shows a game's latest Steam news and patch notes in a News tab on its library page, next to Activity and Your Stuff, plus new Madness Workshop books for that game. Tap a post to read it in Desk's reader view (no ads).

You can hide the tab for any game from the tab itself. In the Scroll's ⚙ Settings you can show news as a section under Play instead, or turn off the library news or the Workshop books. The News Tome shows the same for the game on your Desk.
author: MarshyMadness
